tankcompressor-notice-destroyed: Tank destroyed. Displaying last recorded data.
tankcompressor-save-tooltip: Save the record selected to an inserted data disk.
techweb-node-ai-desc: Exploration of AI systems, more intelligent than the entire crew put together.
techweb-node-ai_laws-desc: Delving into sophisticated AI directives, with hopes that they won't lead to humanity's extinction.
techweb-node-anomaly_research-desc: Delving into the study of mysterious anomalies to investigate methods to refine and harness their unpredictable energies.
techweb-node-anomaly_shells-desc: New shells designed to utilize anomaly cores, maximizing their potential in innovative ways.
techweb-node-applied_bluespace-desc: With a heightened grasp of bluespace dynamics, sophisticated applications and technologies can be devised using data from bluespace crystal analyses.
techweb-node-atmos-desc: Maintaining station air and related life support systems.
techweb-node-augmentation-desc: For those who prefer shiny metal over squishy flesh.
techweb-node-basic_arms-desc: Ballistics can be unpredictable in space.
techweb-node-bci-desc: Embedded brain circuits. May occasionally stream Nanotrasen ads in dreams.
techweb-node-beam_weapons-desc: So advanced, even engineers are baffled by its operational principles.
techweb-node-bepis_aus_security-desc: It is said that security in the Australicus sector is tight, so we took some pointers from their equipment. Thankfully, our sector lacks any signs of these, 'dropbears'.
techweb-node-bepis_extreme_office-desc: Some of our smartest lab guys got together on a Friday and improved our office efficiency by 350%. Here's how.
techweb-node-bepis_light_apps-desc: Applications of lighting and vision technology not originally thought to be commercially viable.
techweb-node-bepis_mod_experimental-desc: Applications of experimentality when creating MODsuits have created these...
techweb-node-bepis_posisphere-desc: Recent developments on cost-cutting measures have allowed us to cut positronic brain cubes into twice-as-cheap spheres. Unfortunately, it also allows them to move around the lab via rolling maneuvers.
techweb-node-bepis_spec_eng-desc: Conventional wisdom has deemed these engineering products 'technically' safe, but far too dangerous to traditionally condone.
techweb-node-bepis_sticky_advanced-desc: Taking a good joke too far? Nonsense!
techweb-node-bio_scan-desc: Advanced technology for analyzing patient health and reagent compositions, ensuring precise diagnostics and treatment in the medical bay.
techweb-node-bitrunning-desc: Bluespace technology has led to the development of quantum-scale computing, which unlocks the means to materialize atomic structures while executing advanced programs.
techweb-node-bluespace_theory-desc: Basic studies into the mysterious alternate dimension known as bluespace.
techweb-node-bluespace_travel-desc: Facilitate teleportation methods based on bluespace principles to revolutionize logistical efficiency.
techweb-node-borg_medical-desc: Let them follow Asimov's First Law.
techweb-node-borg_mining-desc: To mine places too dangerous for humans.
techweb-node-borg_service-desc: Let them do the cookin' by the book.
techweb-node-borg_utility-desc: Let them wipe our floors for us.
techweb-node-botany_equip-desc: Essential tools for maintaining onboard gardens, supporting plant growth in the unique environment of the space station.
techweb-node-cafeteria_equip-desc: When standard-issue tubed food no longer satisfies the station crew's appetite...
techweb-node-chem_synthesis-desc: Synthesizing complex chemicals from electricity and thin air... Don't ask how...
techweb-node-consoles-desc: User-friendly consoles for non-technical crew members, enhancing communication and access to essential station information.
techweb-node-construction-desc: Tools and essential machinery used for station maintenance and expansion.
techweb-node-cryostasis-desc: The result of clown accidentally drinking a chemical, now repurposed for safely preserving crew members in suspended animation.
techweb-node-cyber_combat_implants-desc: To make sure that you can wake the f*** up, samurai.
techweb-node-cyber_cyber_implants-desc: Advanced technological enhancements integrated into the body, offering improved physical capabilities.
techweb-node-cyber_cyber_organs-desc: We have the technology to rebuild him.
techweb-node-cyber_cyber_organs_adv-desc: Cutting-edge cybernetic organs offering enhanced sensory capabilities, making it easier than ever to detect ERP.
techweb-node-cyber_cyber_organs_upgraded: We have the technology to upgrade him.
techweb-node-cyber_integrated_toolsets-d: Decades of contraband smuggling by assistants have led to the development of a full toolbox that fits seamlessly into your arm.
techweb-node-cybernetics-desc: Sapient robots with preloaded tool modules and programmable laws.
